why: The HNA five-domain competency framework is a named professional competency framework for assessing haemophilia specialist nurses and identifying development needs, not a general theory of learning.
name: UK Haemophilia Nurses Association competency framework
product_description: A professional competency framework developed by the UK Haemophilia Nurses Association that defines five domains and four practice levels for assessing and supporting the development of haemophilia specialist nurses.

name: Home Newspaper Utilization Scale for Elementary School Students (HNUS-E), Activities factor
